description: This file defines API endpoints for managing containers within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and deleting containers, all conforming to the OpenAI Containers API spec. The code heavily relies on route dependencies, request processing, and external utility functions for provider extraction.
